name: Fabula
summary:
---------------------------------- **LIMITED ACCESS** -----------------------------

**(Opens only on weekends)**

You're a tiny bearlet. You're inside a fairytale village. You've got 10 minutes to swallow every magical artifact in sight and flush yourself out before another critter steals your haul. This is Fabula. 

A **free** VR extraction adventure for Quest 2 & 3 — mischievous fairy-tale critters, storybook raids, and the funniest inventory system in VR.

# 🍝 EAT THE TALE 
Your belly IS your inventory
